name: Playtime
description: A self-serve tournament bracket manager for a one-night bar event.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs admin and baby session cookies.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Seeds the first Daddy account on the very first deploy only — the seed script is idempotent and won't touch it again.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Seeds the first Daddy account on the very first deploy only. Change it from the admin panel afterwards.

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.description: This app's own public URL, no trailing slash (e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com) — used to build Telegram deep links and register the webhook. Not known until after the first deploy; set it once you have the real Heroku URL, then redeploy.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: From @BotFather. Optional — without it the bot no-ops (logs instead of sending).

TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME.description: The bot's @username, without the @. Optional, same as above.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Verifies incoming webhook requests are really from Telegram.

THEME.description: nursery (default, ABDL-coded) or plain (neutral skin for screenshots/testing).
